product: SmartCiti.X : Trade Craft Academy (powered by AGI Corp)
honesty: Quests, games, treasures, easter eggs and badges are play: they are kept on this device only, they are never evidence of anything, and they never enter a completion record.

quests.title: Signal caller
quests.hint: Give the signal the lift card calls, in order, before the clock runs out; finish on STOP.
quests.unlock_text: To unlock: walk "Call the first lift before anybody touches the hook", "Walk where the bundle will fly before it flies".

quests.title: Chart or refuse
quests.hint: Judge each pick against the chart line at its radius: hook it or refuse it.
